name: Dr Julia Garami
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: I am passionate about helping clients turn emotional challenges into emotional growth by combining a warm approach with evidence-based therapy. I believe that everyone has inner strengths and resources to overcome challenges and has the potential to live a rich and meaningful life. I work with adults and young people experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, child behavioural issues and oppositional behaviour, self-harm, suicidal ideation, obsessive compulsive symptoms, low-self esteem and life setbacks. I use a number of approaches, including cognitive behavioural therapy and acceptance and commitment therapy, Internal Family Systems Therapy and EMDR.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR

name: Dr Phoebe Lau
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: With over a decade in the mental health field, I am a clinical psychologist dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based care. I founded The Inner Collective, a Melbourne-based private practice offering culturally responsive, neuroaffirming, and trauma-informed support. My special interests lie in trauma, neuroaffirming practices, and infertility – areas where I empower individuals through education, self-awareness, and practical strategies.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sex worker issues, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Clare Billings
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Clare is a Clinical Psychologist and Supervisor (PsyBA and ANZICA) who provides telehealth-based neurodiversity-affirming psychology services to people in Australia who are 16 years old or older. Clare strives to provide psychological care that is LGBTIQAP+ inclusive and respectful of different races, religions and cultures, including those of First Nations peoples.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities

name: Daniel Wraith-Franck
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I'm Daniel, a registered clinical psychologist with a deep curiosity about people's inner worlds, histories, and relationships. I aim to create a space that feels emotionally safe – free from assumptions, judgment, or pressure. My work is grounded in trauma-informed, evidence-based approaches such as Internal Family Systems (IFS) and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR). I've been shaped by mentors I deeply respect, and over time, I've developed a process of gently weaving relations – between parts of ourselves, our past and present, and our relationships. I've supported people through anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, shame and obsessions – across diverse settings, including First Nations, migrant, and Western communities.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Partners/families of sex offenders, EMDR

name: Daria Sizenko
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: *** Currently accepting new clients*** I am a registered psychologist experienced in working with mood and anxiety disorders, trauma and stress-related disorders, impulse control and behavioural regulation issues, problematic substance use and addictive behaviours, issues related to intimacy and sexuality, as well as providing general mental health support. I provide a compassionate, neurodiversity affirming, non-judgemental environment where one can actively explore their current challenges.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties, Sex offenders, EMDR

Here are some of the areas we can help you with: - Anxiety - Depression - Stress & burnout - Trauma & emotional difficulties - Couples counselling - Individual relationship issues - Eating & body image concerns - Life changes - Personal growth & wellbeing - ADHD and autism

name: Alicia Shevlin
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Alicia Shevlin is a Melbourne-based psychologist offering telehealth services across Australia. She specialises in psychodynamic therapy, a reflective approach that goes beyond basic symptom management. Alicia works with mood & anxiety disorders, trauma, grief & loss, relationship difficulties, workplace stress, eating disorders, problematic substance use, identity-related issues, & sexual concerns. Alicia works with adults across the lifespan & supports people of all genders, sexual orientations & sex characteristics, including intersex people, & has experience working with the trans community.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues
